calibration: RGBA PNGs copied without resize, crop, flip, or pixel edits. Optical body height calibrated to 56 world px using alpha>=128 bounds; displaySize = 56 * sourceHeight / alpha128 body height. Origin x is the alpha-weighted centroid across alpha>=128 pixels in the bottom 50 rows of the alpha128 body; origin y is the last alpha>=128 row divided by source height. Four independently drawn orientations. WebP assets encoded losslessly and verified RGBA-identical to raw PNG sources.
